anigraha.m: mfn. unrestrained; a-nigraha m. non-restraint, non-refutation, not owning one's self refuted.

abhiyoga.m: m. application; energetic effort, exertion, perseverance in, constant practice (with loc. or inf.); attack, assault, &c.; (in law) a plaint, a charge, accusation, &c.

anuyā.m: anu-√ yā to go towards or after, follow; to imitate, equal.; anu-yā/ mfn. following

abhyupetya.mw: ind.p. having arrived at (acc.); having entered; having assented or agreed to.

kathāprasaṅga.m: m. occasion to speak or talk; course of conversation; kathā-prasaṅga mfn. talkative, talking much, half-witted; a conjurer, dealer in antidotes &c.

(prob. fr. √ viś, to pervade, cf.; declined as a pron. like sarva, by which it is superseded in the Brāhmaṇas and later language) all, every, every one; whole, entire, universal, &c. &c.; all-pervading or all-containing, omnipresent (applied to Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa, the soul, intellect &c.),; …

mṛdi.m: m. N. of a man (cf. mārdeya).

(g. svar-ādi) preferably, rather, better (also = preferable, sometimes with abl. which in Veda is often followed by ā, e.g. agni/bhyo va/ram, ‘better than fires’,; sa/khibhya ā/ va/ram, ‘better than companions’,; exceptionally with acc., e.g. śiṣyaiḥ śata-hutān homān, ekaḥ …
